name: emw-relion-transform_volume
help: Transform a volume with relion_image_handler: rescale (to a pixel size, by a binning factor or to a box size), crop/pad the box, flip or invert the hand, shift, invert contrast and filter. RELION applies the operations in this order: remove NaN, invert contrast, B-factor, low-pass, high-pass, flip, shift, rescale, crop/pad. The output header always gets the resulting pixel size. Input: a Volume. Output: the transformed Volume.

params.name: relion_image_handler.angpix
params.label: Input pixel size (Å):
params.help: Pixel size of the input volume (--angpix). Use -1 to read it from the volume header. Set it when the header value is missing or wrong; the output header will then be corrected as well.

params.name: relion_image_handler.force_angpix
params.label: Output pixel size (Å):
params.help: Write this pixel size in the output header (--force_header_angpix) instead of the computed one, without changing the data. Use -1 to keep the computed pixel size.

params.name: relion_image_handler.float16
params.label: Write float16:
params.help: Write the output in half precision (MRC mode 12) instead of 32-bit float (--float16). Not all programs can read it.

params.name: relion_image_handler.rescale_mode
params.label: Rescale:
params.help: Rescale the volume in Fourier space (--rescale_angpix), keeping the same physical size. The new box is rounded to an even size, so the real pixel size might differ slightly from the requested one; the real value is written to the output header.

params.name: relion_image_handler.binning
params.label: Binning factor:
params.help: New pixel size = input pixel size x binning. Values below 1 upsample the volume.

params.name: relion_image_handler.rescale_box
params.label: Target box size (px):
params.help: Even box size in pixels of the rescaled volume. The pixel size becomes input box x input pixel size / target box.

params.name: relion_image_handler.new_box
params.label: Crop/pad to box (px):
params.help: Crop (smaller) or zero-pad (larger) the volume around its center to this box size, without changing the pixel size (--new_box). Applied after rescaling. Use -1 to keep the box.

params.name: relion_image_handler.flip
params.label: Flip / hand:
params.help: Mirror the volume along one axis (--flipX/--flipY/--flipZ), or invert the hand (--invert_hand): like flipping X but keeping the symmetry origin, the recommended option to fix the handedness of a map.

params.name: relion_image_handler.shift_com
params.label: Center by center of mass:
params.help: Shift the volume so its center of mass (positive values only) is at the box center (--shift_com).

params.name: relion_image_handler.invert_contrast
params.label: Invert contrast:
params.help: Multiply the values by -1 (--multiply_constant -1), e.g. to match the contrast of a template with the tomograms.

params.name: relion_image_handler.lowpass
params.label: Low-pass (Å):
params.help: Low-pass filter resolution in Å (--lowpass). Use -1 for none.

params.name: relion_image_handler.highpass
params.label: High-pass (Å):
params.help: High-pass filter resolution in Å (--highpass). Use -1 for none.

params.name: relion_image_handler.filter_edge_width
params.label: Filter edge width (shells):
params.help: Width of the raised cosine edge of the low/high-pass filters, in resolution shells (--filter_edge_width).

params.name: relion_image_handler.bfactor
params.label: B-factor (Å²):
params.help: Apply this B-factor (--bfactor): negative values sharpen, positive values blur. Use 0 for none.
